name: xflickr_no_calls_pending

query_condition.sql: SELECT max(calls_last_10min) AS calls, max(pending_items) AS pending FROM "{{OPENOBSERVE_STREAM}}" WHERE event='crawl.health' HAVING calls=0 AND pending>0

description: Impact: Pending work is not progressing because no granted Flickr call is being made. Action: Check scheduler, keys, quota, and worker availability.
